name: Kill-All Go!
storyline: Captured by an obsessive Go-fanatic, our protagonist must fight against a suffocating turn-limit and clear her Countdown Collar before she finds herself exploded (yowch!)
summary: Have you ever played Go (or Weiqi, or Baduk, or whatever you want to call it)? Cool! Have you ever played it with your life on the line? No better time to start than now! Collect upgrades, puzzle through rounds, and... wait, is this another indie dev team making a roguelike?

videos.name: Dev Diary
videos.title: THE DEATH GAME GENRE IS DEAD WHEN I SAY ITS DEAD
